instruction: Edit the image on the Desktop by flipping it horizontally as specified in the requirements, then save the new version as 'pic.jpg' to the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: This task requires the agent to flip the image horizontally (mirror). The evaluator checks if the resulting image is a horizontal mirror of the original by flipping the result back and comparing with the original using SSIM (structural similarity index) with a threshold of 0.99.

llm_judge_reasons: Semantic verification logic is correct: the evaluator verifies horizontal flip by flipping the result back and comparing with the original using SSIM (threshold 0.99)
Complete coverage: both requirements are verified - (1) file saved as pic.jpg on Desktop (getter checks file existence), (2) image is horizontally flipped (metric verifies mirror correctness)
Expected value correctness: original_path correctly points to the source image from config
Getter logic correctness: correctly extracts result image from VM path and saves to local cache
Metric logic correctness: correctly implements mirror verification with robust edge case handling (missing files, size mismatches, small images, RGB conversion, dynamic SSIM window sizing)
Data flow is correct: result path -> getter downloads file -> metric receives local path -> flips and compares -> returns score
No critical semantic or logical issues found
